finding.finding: Only the authoritative BER18 hardware fault is an operational claim supported by eligible evidence.

S01 equipment failure is verified. EQ-S01 is available, and C1/C2 have the required equipment skill; the listed road to S01 is open. No safety or impossibility evidence supports deferring any action. No generator deployment is indicated because S01 grid power is working. No blocking unknowns require operator questions.
